description: This file defines a Doctrine ORM event listener class EmployeeListener that manages encryption and decryption of Employee entity's SSN number during various lifecycle events such as pre-update, post-update, and post-load.

classes.name: EmployeeListener
classes.description: A Doctrine event listener for handling encryption and decryption of Employee SSN data during entity lifecycle events.

methods.name: preUpdate
methods.description: Encrypts the SSN number of Employee before database update if the field has changed and encryption is enabled.

methods.name: postUpdate
methods.description: Decrypts the SSN number of Employee after database update if encryption is enabled.

methods.name: postLoad
methods.description: Decrypts the SSN number of Employee after it is loaded from the database if encryption is enabled.
